title: Women's Marathon World Rankings: November 2026
desc: The top ten in World Athletics' women's Marathon (Half Marathon-25km-30km) event ranking as of 10 November 2026. Values are ranking points, not race times; associated events can contribute. This dated snapshot covers only the top ten and the live source may change.

source.name: World Athletics — Women’s Marathon World Rankings
source.note: Verified by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-11-16 against the official World Athletics event ranking: all ten names, countries, places, scores and the 10 November 2026 reference date, including the eleventh-place cutoff. Only the first ten are included; ETH and KEN map to ET and KE. The event ranking includes associated half marathon, 25km and 30km events; points are not race times. The live table may change.
